nameJa: 名称と機能のロックアップ
headline: YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen
conceptNote: 正式名称と動画・チャットを横方向に結び、全体を一つのブランド形に。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. ONE sophisticated Chrome extension listing image, compact landscape11:7 target1760x1120, not a collage. Design a SINGLE LARGE FULLSCREEN VIDEO FRAME on a warm-white background. The frame has a dark-ink outline and four clear fullscreen corner marks, centered with generous white outer margins. INSIDE the frame place the complete product name in the LEFT area on three lines, EXACT reading order: "YouTube" / "Live Chat" / "Fullscreen". ALL letters must be INSIDE the video frame. Use beautiful LIGHT contemporary sans, weight300, thin elegant stems, airy counters, exact optical kerning; Live Chat may be slightly italic but readable. Not bold or chunky.
In the RIGHT area INSIDE THE SAME FRAME, one flat vermilion-red chat pane overlays the otherwise empty white video surface, with a clear gap on all four sides. Pane about25% video width, contains three offwhite avatar dots and abstract message strokes, plus a discreet input/send line. A small red play triangle below the product name on the left balances this pane. The blank space inside the frame is the video. Type and chat need comfortable spacing and shared alignment, whole composition calm and precise. Product name and video are one integrated graphic, not an external title plus an unrelated icon.
Only visible words are the exact full name "YouTube Live Chat Fullscreen", each word once and in that order; no other text anywhere, no logo copy. Large enough to read at220x140. Preserve7%canvas margins. Frame should feel16:9, never stretched into ultrawide strip. No scenery, no mountains, no lakes/trees/sun, no image inside video, no additional panel outside frame, no dashboard, no 3D, no shadows, no glossy surfaces, no decorative shapes, no extra labels, captions or watermark. Flat refined editorial graphic with highly considered whitespace.
